description: This file defines the DeprecatedNode class, which represents a node in the Twig template engine's abstract syntax tree for deprecated features. It includes methods for compiling this node into executable PHP code, primarily to trigger deprecation warnings during template rendering.

classes.description: Represents a deprecated node in the Twig template AST, used to generate code that triggers deprecation warnings.

methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code that triggers a deprecation warning.
